entry_rules.entry_stop_hunt_reclaim: Long regime: hunt wick reclaim, RSI (50,80).
entry_rules.entry_fractal_hunt_long: Long regime: fractal low + hunt reclaim.
entry_rules.entry_rsi50_cross_long: Long regime: RSI crosses up through 50.
entry_rules.entry_stack_flip_long: First stacked long bar after chop (transition).
entry_rules.entry_retest_ema21: Short regime: reject EMA21 from below, RSI (20,50).
entry_rules.entry_fractal_hunt_short: Short regime: fractal high + hunt reject.
entry_rules.entry_rsi50_cross_short: Short regime: RSI crosses down through 50.

exit_rules.exit_ema21_break: Long: close below EMA21. Short: close above EMA21.
exit_rules.exit_regime_lost: Stack alignment lost for 2 consecutive bars.
exit_rules.exit_atr_trail_1p5: Initial stop 1.5×ATR; trail to breakeven after 1×ATR profit.
exit_rules.exit_scale_rsi70_long: Long partial logic proxy: exit when RSI >= 75.

questions.why_enter_now: Use enter_advice: GOOD grade + entry rule + historical win% from design split.
questions.why_hold_or_close: Use hold_*_advice columns: EMA21 break, RSI 80/20, stack grade.
questions.will_i_win_if_i_enter: Filter matrix where chart_grade=GOOD and split=validation or OOS; check winrate & exp_bps.
